tips: Businesses keep earning while you're away, up to their storage limit.
Collect often: a full till stops earning.
Upgrades raise both income and storage capacity.
Crews travel on real streets. Arterials and bridges are faster than side streets.
A crew stationed at a business protects it.
Tap a crew, then Send, then tap a building or street to move it.
Pinch to zoom out for the strategic view of the city.
Complete every chapter objective to claim its reward.
